question: Which of the following statements best represents a real-world example of ‘blurred boundaries’ in remote work as described in the passage?

options.text: A worker who is required to come into the office every day but also frequently works from home due to personal reasons, resulting in reduced social interaction with co-workers.
A worker who is easily distracted by personal responsibilities and household chores during their remote work hours, leading to decreased productivity and missed deadlines.
An employee who sets up a dedicated workspace in their home and follows a structured work schedule to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
An employee who works from home occasionally responds to work emails after their normal working hours, leading to burnout and decreased productivity.

solution:
The correct answer is **"An employee who works from home occasionally responds to work emails after their normal working hours, leading to burnout and decreased productivity."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the challenge of blurred boundaries between work and personal life in the context of remote work.
 
• This refers to the difficulty in distinguishing between work time and personal time when working from home, which can lead to stress, burnout, and decreased productivity.
 
• Option 4 presents a scenario where an employee, while working from home, occasionally responds to work emails after their standard working hours.
 
• This behaviour exemplifies the **'blurred boundaries' **concept, as it shows how work responsibilities can invade personal time, potentially leading to burnout and decreased job satisfaction.
 
• The passage underscores the importance of setting clear boundaries between work and personal life as a measure to combat the drawbacks associated with remote work, such as decreased productivity and the negative impact on mental health.
 
• By engaging in work-related activities outside of normal working hours, as described in Option 4, the employee demonstrates the challenge in achieving a healthy work-life balance that is pivotal in remote work settings.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• While Option 2 indeed illustrates a situation where personal responsibilities impact work productivity, it does not as directly capture the issue of work activities extending into personal time which more closely aligns with the concept of blurred boundaries discussed in the passage.
 
• Options 1 and 3 either emphasize different challenges associated with remote work or describe scenarios that are contrary to the blurred boundaries issue, making them less fitting examples of the particular concern addressed in the passage and corrected response.
